theorems.name: BobFormal.MergeGate.merge_needs_approval
theorems.statement: No pull request is merged unless an approval for that exact pull request is approved.

theorems.name: BobFormal.MergeGate.approved_by_person
theorems.statement: An approval only becomes approved through the person's decision; no agent call can approve one.

theorems.name: BobFormal.MergeGate.merge_traces_to_person
theorems.statement: Every merged pull request has an approval for it that a person approved somewhere in the history.

theorems.name: BobFormal.MergeGate.approval_does_not_pin_head
theorems.statement: Known gap: the approval is not tied to a head, so commits pushed after the person was asked are what gets merged.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Mailbox.first_sends_within_budget
theorems.statement: In one request, agents start at most 12 deliveries of new work.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Mailbox.deliveries_bounded
theorems.statement: When every reply answers one owed ask, a request sees at most 24 agent deliveries, so every message cascade ends.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Mailbox.agent_messages_bounded
theorems.statement: At most 24 agent messages are accepted in one request; after that every agent send is refused.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Mailbox.send_message_replies_unbounded
theorems.statement: Known gap: through send_message, two person-added teammates can keep replying to each other's replies without limit, because replies skip the budget.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Roadmap.step_shape
theorems.statement: Every roadmap call either leaves the stage alone or is an advance by exactly one stage from a stage whose gate holds.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Roadmap.stage_monotone
theorems.statement: The roadmap never moves back a stage.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Roadmap.stages_in_order
theorems.statement: The stages the roadmap has left are exactly 1, 2, ... up to the current one, in order, so no stage is ever skipped.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Trace.every_message_traces_to_person
theorems.statement: Following causedBy from any message always ends at a message a person sent.

theorems.name: BobFormal.Trace.no_causal_cycles
theorems.statement: No message is its own cause, however far back you follow causedBy.
